LABORATORY · PERMANENT RESEARCH
WAR ROOM · CHOOSE YOUR NEXT MISSION

Replay earlier regions to farm materials. The frontier advances when you win your highest unlocked region.

Deploy goblins to destroy the enemy fortress. Units march and fight automatically. Each unit costs gold and has a separate cooldown. Having enough gold does not bypass the cooldown. Mouse deployment activates on press, so rapid updates cannot swallow your click. Workshop coins and scrap are separate from battle gold.

Win or lose, you earn resources. Spend them on training, equipment, and research. Earn new goblins by defeating bosses in later regions. There are no ads, energy systems, or purchases.

Keyboard: 1–9, 0 deploy · Space fires cannon · P pauses · M toggles music. Music and effects are generated by your browser; no external files are needed.

Saving: Progress uses the same save key as v0.4. Browser storage for local HTML files can vary by file path, so export your v0.4 save before switching and import it here if necessary.
